body:
Milestone 9 (project-pages), research half: gives `research/alias-twin` a figure for its home page.

- `experiments/figure.py` parses section 2 of the committed `results.txt` (nothing retyped) and writes `experiments/rmse_vs_speed.svg`: RMSE vs true speed for the naive estimator on aliased data, the grid-search unfolded estimator and the twin simulation. No plotting dependency.
- `tests/test_figure.py` (2 tests) checks parsing and that the committed SVG matches the generator.
- README reproduce line added. `python site/build.py` prints `ok` and `_site/alias-twin/` now carries the figure. alias-twin tests: 10 pass.

Stylised simulation only; no new results were produced.
